voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Lima, Peru. Eighteen twenty. The story goes that the city's riches were loaded onto one ship, among them a life-size Virgin of solid gold.
Its captain, it is said, sailed instead for Cocos Island, off Costa Rica, and buried it there.
More than three hundred expeditions have searched the island since. None found the treasure.
One man, August Gissler, searched there for nearly twenty years. He found a few gold coins.
Some historians doubt it happened. Costa Rica now forbids treasure hunting there. The gold, if it existed, has never been found.
